protocol.action: Same original four-scalar tree action and matched couplings. a=1,b=.1,g=.1,d/g²=.01,mD0²/(g²v²)=1,alpha0; D background zero.
protocol.time_radius_units: tau=g*v*t, rho=g*v*r; s generator exponent e^(s*tau), frequency nu=Im(s) for stable positive-frequency roots
protocol.boundaries: uniform interior rho=jL/(N+1); Dirichlet transformed fields at rho=0,L; S(L)=1
protocol.background: consistent fixed-Omega finite-difference stationary p=rho F,z=rho(S-1), Newton max15 iterations, max residual1e-10; no physical fit; retain failures
protocol.controls: full dense spectra at two spacings; sparse low-frequency/real-axis probes at two spacings and one larger box; phase and translation overlap/residuals; exact discrete charge-left-null check; amplitude constrained and phase energy eigenvalues
protocol.higher_ell_scope: K_ell=K_2+[ell(ell+1)-6]/rho² for ell>=2; numerical K2 positivity plus this algebraic comparison supports higher-ell energy test without infinite scan; continuum positivity is conditional on converged background/operator.
protocol.time_budget_behavior: do not start another grid once elapsed budget exceeded; record skipped grids; no paid compute or installs
